proved_step: Lemma A (indicator degree): for Z subset {0,1}^t, deg_F2(1_Z) = t iff |Z| is odd (top ANF coefficient = |Z| mod 2). Lemma A' (Reed-Muller weight): a nonzero multilinear F2 polynomial of degree d has at least 2^(t-d) nonzero points, so deg_F2(1_Z) >= t - log2|Z| for nonempty Z. Lemma B (repair): for any encoding E: {0,1}^t -> {0,1}^S with component degrees d_j and zero class Z0 = E^{-1}(E(0^t)), sum_j d_j >= t - log2|Z0|. Proof: P(x) = prod_j (1+E_j(x)+E_j(0^t)) equals 1_{Z0}(x); deg P <= sum_j d_j; deg 1_{Z0} >= t - log2|Z0| by A'. Consequences: sum_j d_j >= t when Z0 = {0^t} (the original sketch) and when |Z0| is odd (Lemma A).
